body: Forward test of the promise-tracker credibility method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.52 (naive base rate 0.40) that: Deckers FY27 diluted EPS is ≥$7.95 (top of its $7.80–7.95 guide). Evidence: 8-K 22-Oct-2026 (Q2 FY27): record revenue $1.48B; EPS $2.31 (+27%) incl. $0.28 IEEPA tariff-refund benefit; gross margin 60.5% (56.2%). FY27 guide raised: net sales $5.700–5.725B, GM ~58.5%, op margin ~23%, EPS $7.80–7.95 incl. ~$0.52 refund benefit; assumes $1.0B buyback. CEO Stefano Caroti: 'a challenging consumer environment… taking deliberate' actions in H2. Reasoning: Deckers has a reputation for conservative guidance (track record not yet coded in promise tracker), but the CEO's own words flag a tougher H2 and the range is narrow. Modestly above base. Resolution: YES if Deckers' reported FY27 (ending 31-Mar-2027) diluted EPS (Q4 FY27 earnings release) ≥ $7.95, as reported (including tariff-refund effects). Source: Deckers Q4 FY27 earnings 8-K (SEC EDGAR, CIK 910521). Resolve by 2027-06-05; score with Brier vs base rate.
